title: Web megolith split evidence
completed: Moved the declarative Web route table out of WebChannel.startup() into channel/web/routes.py.
Moved Web auth, SSE, sessions/history/UI state, runtime projection, file, image job, capabilities, and diagnostics route handlers into dedicated modules.
Kept extracted handler class names imported into web_channel.py so existing web.py string handler routing stays compatible.
Split inline action normalization/rendering/synchronization out of console.js into channel/web/static/js/inline-actions.js.
Loaded inline-actions.js before console.js in chat.html.
Added S8 structural regression assertions for route table, handler ownership modules, and frontend module load order.
transitionalBridges: handler_support.py calls legacy web_channel auth/workspace helpers so existing tests and security semantics stay intact.
files.py, image_jobs.py, sessions.py, diagnostics.py, projection.py, and sse.py call existing web_channel helper functions where moving helpers would expand blast radius.
console.js keeps wrapper functions so existing call sites continue to work while implementation lives in inline-actions.js.
postReviewFixes: Changed sessions.py failed agent-memory-sync logging from raw exception text to web_body_log_summary(sync_err).
Main thread rechecked web_channel.py line count after architecture note; current line count remains 11958 and matches this artifact.
notComplete: Deep helper/service extraction from web_channel.py remains future work after S8; this slice focuses on route-handler ownership and frontend module split.
InstallationsHandler and several configuration/channel handlers remain in web_channel.py for later slices because they were not part of the immediate S8 risk path.
